## mcp

**Purpose:** JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP resource server exposing 4 read-only tools to Claude clients: `list_audits`, `get_audit`, `get_screenshots`, `get_project_context`. Handles `initialize`, `tools/list`, and `tools/call` methods. Unauthenticated GET/HEAD returns 401 + `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` so Claude can discover the AS via RFC 9728.
**Auth:** Bearer token validated as SHA-256 hash against `mcp_sessions` table (OAuth 2.1 access token issued by `mcp-auth`). Expired and revoked sessions rejected.
**Key inputs:** JSON-RPC body `{jsonrpc, method, params?, id}` for tool calls; `project_id?` (list_audits), `audit_id` (get_audit, get_screenshots), `project_id` (get_project_context)
**Discovery:** `public/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` points to AS; `public/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` has full AS metadata including `registration_endpoint`
**Shared modules:** `supabase-env.ts`

---

## mcp-auth

**Purpose:** OAuth 2.1 Authorization Server for the MCP integration. Handles Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591), authorization code flow with PKCE (S256), token issuance, token refresh (not yet implemented), session revocation, and user-denial redirect. State stored in `mcp_auth_state`; sessions (hashed tokens) in `mcp_sessions`.
**Auth:** `?action=authorize` — no auth (redirects browser); `?action=exchange` — supabase-jwt (user must be logged in on consent page); `?action=token` — no auth (PKCE is the security boundary); `?action=revoke` — supabase-jwt; `?action=register` — no auth (public DCR per RFC 7591); `?action=deny` — no auth (uses session_key)
**Key actions:** `register` (POST) → returns `client_id` UUID; `authorize` (GET) → stores PKCE state, redirects to `/auth/mcp/authorize` consent page; `exchange` (POST) → issues auth code after user approves; `token` (POST, accepts both `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` and JSON) → validates PKCE + issues access + refresh tokens; `deny` (POST) → cleans up state, returns error redirect URL; `revoke` (POST) → marks all user MCP sessions as revoked
**Redirect allowlist:** `localhost` (any port) for Claude Desktop/Code; `claude.ai` for web
**Shared modules:** `supabase-env.ts`, `cors.ts`, `log-error.ts`
